name: CARBONEUM OXYGENISATUM
key_symptoms: Cerebral congestion; hallucination of vision, hearing and touch. Inclination to turn in a circle. Jaws firmly clenched. Trismus. Heaviness of head. Sticking pain in temples. Roaring ears.
guiding_symptoms: Cerebral congestion; hallucination of vision, hearing and touch. Inclination to turn in a circle. Jaws firmly clenched. Trismus. Heaviness of head. Sticking pain in temples. Roaring ears.
head_symptoms: Cerebral congestion; hallucination of vision, hearing and touch. Inclination to turn in a circle. Jaws firmly clenched. Trismus. Heaviness of head. Sticking pain in temples. Roaring ears.
skin_symptoms: Anæsthesia; vesication along course of nerves; herpes zoster; pemphigus, with large and small vesicles. Hand icy cold.
sleep_symptoms: Deep. Prolonged; sleepiness for several days.

source.title: CARBONEUM OXYGENISATUM - HOMOEOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA - By William BOERICKE
